Why E-IX
One account on every device

Apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, plus a package for OpenWrt routers. Sign in everywhere with the same account; the console shows how many devices are online.

Automatic setup

Sign in and the app picks up its settings from your account. There is nothing to configure.

Published limits

Every plan states its data, devices online at once and bandwidth cap. The console shows data used and, on monthly plans, the days left until the next reset.

Account security

Sign in with a passkey or add two-step verification. Review signed-in devices, sign any of them out, and delete your account yourself at any time.

Ticket support

Open a ticket from the console; every request has a record and a reply. The help center has step-by-step guides for each platform.

Data on a set cycle

Monthly plans reset data on your billing date. 1024G is a one-time allowance valid for 12 months.
